name: massdo-skills
description: Skills for response style and extracting information from messy text: short ASD-STE100 answers, articulate replies, a chief-of-staff stance, and extract-signal.

interface.longDescription: Borner la longueur des réponses en anglais technique simplifié ASD-STE100 transposé au français, write articulate replies under an optional word cap, take a chief-of-staff stance that decides instead of offering menus, and extract the information in messy text while preserving meaning and uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Use $massdo-skills:articulate 100 to write articulately under a word cap.
Use $massdo-skills:extract-signal to clarify this dictation transcript without losing information.
